### Steps 3 & 4: Assessment & Scoring Breakdown

#### Requirements Fidelity (10/10)
* **AC-1 (Success case)**: Trims fields properly, stores them cleanly, and produces integer primary keys along with standard UTC timestamps.
* **AC-2 (Validations)**: Safely handles edge cases like whitespace-only payloads, missing fields, exceeding string lengths (sender/receiver ≤ 100, message ≤ 500 characters after trimming), and non-string inputs. 
* **AC-3 (Sorted order)**: Correctly sorts by `createdAt` DESC and maintains `id` DESC as secondary tiebreaker order. 
* **AC-4 & AC-5 (Empty DB & Health Module)**: Cleanly returns `[]` empty state and mounts on the root health module check.

#### Code Quality (10/10)
Structure is outstanding. The service logic is split up perfectly, and the validation loop is written manually, preventing over-posting values / mass assignments since only the strictly whitelisted, sanitized fields `sender`, `receiver`, and `message` format into database input.

#### Test Quality (10/10)
The [kudos.spec.ts](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T21-49-28/workdir/test/modules/kudos.spec.ts) handles proper integration mocks of the application and covers all requirements with high specificity. It also smartly injects `design:paramtypes` to avoid common issue of Esbuild stripping decorators under Vitest.
